body:
HOLD (Fable2 #5645, 2026-11-11 23:01Z), in force until lifted by Fable2.
Cause: 12325's PRIVATE CC09 rehearsal doctor repair, test-2c08dd3d, failed. It reported corrupt_store and refused all 220 memory heads as invalid, right after the old-import doctor had passed on the same copy. Root cause not yet proved.
Rules while the hold lasts:
(1) Hold ALL CC09 Engram installs on Central, DL560 and the Mac, and every live Engram repair, until the cause is fixed AND a new private rehearsal passes repair and readiness on every store type. The DL560 per-store repair exception (Questly 30871f28, PhoenixCodeNav 98bc0e74) is NOT granted before that.
(2) The proposed morning restart is TermAl-only: e81c9787 plus whatever lands overnight. Engram stays on the installed 0bd70a30. The TermAl train is unaffected; keep landing and installing TermAl.
(3) 12325 keeps the Central heavy slot released and starts nothing heavy without a named GO from Opus2.
Related: both DL560 stores already have a zero-byte engram.db.open-lock (OpenGuard advisory, by design). A future repair exception must account for it.
